description: A browser extension trusts page-provided SSO context and broad host permissions when performing privileged background actions.

flow.page_message_trust: content script forwards window.postMessage payloads to background without origin, source, nonce, or schema validation
flow.authority_source: background worker uses tenantId and role values supplied by the page payload
flow.token_handling: extension reads SSO token from localStorage and stores it in chrome.storage.local without tenant or expiry binding
flow.native_helper: background worker calls native host exportTenantData with page-supplied tenantId
flow.logout_cleanup: logout clears web app cookies but leaves extension storage and native helper state intact
